description: In an interview with RSBN’s Matthew Alvarez, Senator Wendy Rogers discussed the results of Arizona’s Republican primary, highlighting President Trump’s endorsed candidates and expressing confidence that Andy Biggs can defeat Governor Katie Hobbs in November. title: Wendy Rogers Says Arizona Republicans Are Poised to Flip the Governor’s Office | Wendy Rogers
